# Journal of Cancer

> An international peer-reviewed open-access journal publishing original cancer research, clinical studies, and biomarker discoveries across oncology.

Journal of Cancer is a peer-reviewed scientific journal dedicated to publishing high-quality cancer research and clinical studies. The journal covers diverse oncology topics including immunotherapy, biomarkers, drug sensitivity, and cancer pathology, with articles indexed in PubMed Central and other major databases.

## Journal Overview

- [Journal of Cancer](https://jcancer.org): Homepage for Journal of Cancer, international peer-reviewed cancer research journal
- [About this journal](https://jcancer.org/about): About page describing Journal of Cancer scope, editorial board, and peer-review process
- [Index and ranking - Journal of Cancer](https://jcancer.org/indexrank): Journal impact factor, indexing status (SCI, PubMed), and citation metrics

## Author Guidelines & Submission

- [Instructions for Authors](https://jcancer.org/ms/author): Manuscript submission guidelines, authorship criteria, and plagiarism policies
- [Submission](https://jcancer.org/ms/submit): Manuscript submission portal with requirements and peer-review process information
- [Special issue proposal](https://jcancer.org/specialissue): Guidelines for proposing special issues and guest editor opportunities

## Current Issues & Articles

- [Volume 17, Issue 4](https://jcancer.org/v17i4): Journal of Cancer Volume 17 Issue 4 with cancer research articles
- [Volume 17, Issue 2](https://jcancer.org/v17i2): Journal of Cancer Volume 17 Issue 2 featuring immunotherapy and biomarker research
- [Volume 17, Issue 1](https://jcancer.org/v17i1): Journal of Cancer Volume 17 Issue 1 with glioblastoma and cancer biomarker studies
- [The Overexpression of Myelin and Lymphocyte Protein (MAL) Downregulates MUC1 and Enhances Cisplatin Sensitivity in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer Cells](https://jcancer.org/v17p0703.htm): Research article on MAL protein and cisplatin sensitivity in lung cancer
- [Prognostic Impact of UBA1 Expression in Breast Cancer](https://jcancer.org/v17p0688.htm): Research article on UBA1 as prognostic biomarker in breast cancer
- [A CRM-Integrated ypT Staging System Improves Prognostic Stratification Following Neoadjuvant Therapy in Rectal Cancer](https://jcancer.org/v17p0679.htm): Research article on staging system for rectal cancer after neoadjuvant therapy
